parsed_json.up: Select the ChEMBL identifier and canonical SMILES for all compounds tested against the human adenosine A2a receptor. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then assays, then target_dictionary to match the target. Join compound_structures as an INNER JOIN to require structures. Filter to the human adenosine A2a receptor by target name. Return columns named compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id.
